title: Are You Still the Agent I Authorized? Earned Authority under a Fixed Ceiling for Evolving Agents
abstract: arXiv:2607.23586v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Long-lived AI agents increasingly evolve after deployment by retaining experience, acquiring skills and tools, revising workflows, delegating work, and moving across task phases. This improves adaptation but creates a distinct authorization problem. Tool-enabled agents can turn model errors and prompt injections into consequential external actions; when evolution occurs under a live grant, the subject exercising that authority or the context in which it acts may no longer match what the user evaluated. Evolution can change both the effects reachable under an old grant and the authority required by the task, which may rise, fall, or become incomparable. Existing tool policies constrain actions but do not determine when a grant survives this change. translated_title: 你还是我授权的那个智能体吗？面向演化智能体的固定权限上限下的已获授权
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.23586v2 通知类型：替换 摘要：长寿命AI智能体在部署后会不断演化——通过保留经验、获取技能和工具、修改工作流程、委托任务以及跨任务阶段迁移。这提升了适应性，但也带来了一个独特的授权问题。具备工具能力的智能体可以将模型错误和提示注入转化为具有重大后果的外部行动；当演化发生在有效授权之下时，行使该权限的主体或其所处的情境可能不再与用户当初评估时相匹配。演化既可能改变旧授权下可达的效果范围，也可能改变任务所需的权限，这些权限可能上升、下降或变得无法比较。现有的工具策略只是约束行动，却无法判定授权在何时能经受住这种变化而继续有效。我们提出了“授权连续性”问题：现有授权何时仍然有效，活动权限可以如何变化，以及什么边界必须永远不可移动？我们的状态绑定模型固定了一个传递……
tldr: 该论文提出“授权连续性”这一新问题框架，研究部署后不断演化的AI智能体在何种情况下原有授权依然有效，并提出固定权限上限的状态绑定模型，以确保演化中的智能体不会超越用户最初评估所设定的授权边界。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates the novel problem of authorization continuity for evolving AI agents and proposes a state-bound model with a fixed authority ceiling to determine when an existing grant remains valid as long-lived agents evolve after deployment.
